kaikki_vikisozluk.t: By surface analysis, اَلْ (al-, “the”) + قَمَر (qamar, “moon”) + اَلْ (al-, “the”) + أَكْبَر (ʔakbar, “bigger, greater”), literally “The Greater Moon”.
s: By surface analysis, اَلْ (al-, “the”) + قَمَر (qamar, “moon”) + اَلْ (al-, “the”) + أَكْبَر (ʔakbar, “bigger, greater”), literally “The Greater Moon”
g: Grande Comore (an island of the Comoros).
